INSERT INTO notes (id, board_id, author_id, title, body, source_ticket_id,
                                 source_ticket_key, state, promoted_ticket_id,
                                 promoted_ticket_key, reason, created_at, updated_at, version)
               VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
               RETURNING rid AS "rid!: i64"
